caption:
The drawing depicts the interior of a kitchen or living space. The color palette consists mainly of soft pastel shades, earth tones, greens, browns, and warm wood hues. In the foreground on the left, there is a wooden dining table covered with a white tablecloth with a lace border; on the table are a green patterned jug, matching sugar bowl, a white pitcher, candlesticks, a pink cake under a glass dome, a ceramic bowl, a newspaper, and a cup. Four wooden chairs of different designs surround the table. A blue basin sits on the floor beside the pink-cushioned chair. To the right of the table, there is a large wooden apple bushel basket filled with green apples and a bowl of apples resting on a pink rocking chair. Behind the apples is a wooden step ladder. To the far right, there is a cardboard box labeled "MASON" and "THE LAMP GLASS CO." and some lamp chimneys, next to a shallow sink and a silver cooking pot. A small clock and a rolling pin rest on a wooden counter next to the sink.

In the left background, a floral-patterned sofa with a dark blanket or shawl draped over the arm sits behind a wooden coffee table with potted plants and flowers. The windows behind are covered with sheer lace curtains, and more potted flowers are displayed on the sills and hanging from the ceiling. In the center background, there is a wood stove with ornate details, with a teapot and pumpkin on top, and several kettles lined up next to it. Above the stove, there is a white brick chimney and a large cupboard filled with jars and kitchenware. The surrounding cabinetry is wooden, and shelves are filled with crockery, jars, cookbooks, kitchen utensils, and other food items. To the far right background, a red pump stands on a small raised platform near a window. The walls and ceiling have gray, cream, and tan tones, and the chandelier hanging from the ceiling has gold accents and glass shades. Other decorative elements include plates, vases, lamps, and a clock on shelves. The overall composition is filled with domestic objects, emphasizing the functionality and decor of a lived-in, well-stocked room.
title: Semi-Rural Kitchen and Dining Room, 1910
